facts.business: Linde India Limited is an Indian listed company engaged in industrial gases and related engineering businesses.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to indeterminate effect of related party transactions materiality threshold dispute with SEBI/SAT; Emphasis of Matter on Note 51 regarding SEBI Order dated July 24, 2024, SAT Order dated December 5, 2025, and ongoing Supreme Court appeal regarding valuation of business foregone and received under JV agreement with Praxair India Private Limited.

key_risks: Ongoing regulatory and legal proceedings with SEBI/SAT/Supreme Court regarding related party transaction materiality threshold and valuation of business foregone/received
Indeterminate financial impact of the SEBI Order and SAT Order on standalone financial statements
Uncertainty around shareholder approval for related party transactions (EGM held March 5, 2026 did not approve)
facts.related_party_note: Note 50: Management applied materiality threshold of 10% of annual consolidated turnover per contract with related party (not aggregated). SEBI Order dated July 24, 2024 concluded threshold must be applied on aggregate basis considering all transactions during financial year with a related party, upheld by SAT Order dated December 5, 2025. Company appealed to Supreme Court, outcome awaited. EGM held March 5, 2026 did not approve transactions. Note 51: SEBI Order directed NSE to appoint registered valuer for 'business foregone and received' including 'geographic allocation' under JV Agreement with Praxair India Private Limited. Valuer report dated March 16, 2026 received; Company filed Interlocutory Application before Supreme Court seeking stay. Significant uncertainties exist; impact on financial statements not determinable.
